ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70:30 ratio of high-intensity white to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central low-intensity black region forming an inverted V-shape at the notch; high-intensity white lateral lobes; terminal tips exhibit dense low-intensity black pigmentation; scattered low-intensity pixel clusters (mottling) throughout the white regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central depression with an approximate pixel-depth of 15% of the total fluke height and an internal angle of roughly 55 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular low-frequency serrations with pixel-amplitudes varying between 2-8 pixels; more pronounced jaggedness on the right lobe distal trailing edge compared to the left.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex trailing edge curve sweeping upward toward the distal tips, forming a symmetrical parabolic arc from the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple small, dark circular pixel clusters detected on the white lateral surfaces, particularly concentrated near the right distal tip and along the lower edge of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, high-contrast linear marks (rake marks); three parallel diagonal marks on the mid-left lobe and two intersecting vertical marks on the inner-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Evidence of parallel linear scarring consistent with interspecies interactions on both lobes; heavy irregular pigmentation and potential minor tissue loss at the terminal edges of both tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique large, dark rectangular pigment blotch located in the lower-quadrant of the left white lobe.
